definitions.explanation: An umbrella specifically designed for use in the rain, as opposed to a parasol or sun umbrella.

examples.japanese: {雨傘|あまがさ}を{持|も}ってきた。
{黒|くろ}い{雨傘|あまがさ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a black rain umbrella.

examples.japanese: {折|お}りたたみの{雨傘|あまがさ}をかばんに{入|い}れておくと{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: It's convenient to keep a folding rain umbrella in your bag.

notes:
Distinguishes a rain umbrella from a {日傘|ひがさ} (parasol/sun umbrella). While {傘|かさ} alone usually implies a rain umbrella, {雨傘|あまがさ} is used when the distinction matters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨傘|あまがさ}を{差|さ}す — to put up a rain umbrella
- {折|お}りたたみ{雨傘|あまがさ} — folding rain umbrella
- {雨傘|あまがさ}{立|た}て — umbrella stand

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {傘|かさ} — umbrella (general term, usually implies rain umbrella)
- {日傘|ひがさ} — parasol, sun umbrella
- {相合傘|あいあいがさ} — sharing an umbrella (romantic connotation)
